services.description: Finance - Lease layer STEP L1 services (lease products, applications, requested assets)

service.name: createFinancialProductLease
service.description: Add lease terms to a FinancialProduct whose type is under LEASE. The lease class is derived from the product type.

service.name: updateFinancialProductLease
service.description: Update the lease terms of a lease product (the lease class must stay consistent with the product type)

service.name: deleteFinancialProductLease
service.description: Delete lease terms (fails while applications or asset type rows reference them)

service.name: addFinancialProductLeaseAssetType
service.description: Allow an asset type for a lease product

service.name: removeFinancialProductLeaseAssetType
service.description: Remove an allowed asset type from a lease product

service.name: createLeaseApplication
service.description: Create a lease application in LEASEAPP_RECEIVED status for a lease product

service.name: updateLeaseApplication
service.description: Update a lease application only while it is LEASEAPP_RECEIVED

service.name: deleteLeaseApplication
service.description: Delete a LEASEAPP_RECEIVED application without underwriting, with its requested assets and status history

service.name: setLeaseApplicationStatus
service.description: Change the status of a lease application (StatusValidChange), record history; approval requires requested assets

service.name: createLeaseApplicationAsset
service.description: Add a requested asset to a received lease application

service.name: updateLeaseApplicationAsset
service.description: Update a requested asset of a received lease application

service.name: removeLeaseApplicationAsset
service.description: Remove a requested asset from a received lease application

service.name: createLeaseUnderwriting
service.description: Create a common underwriting (LOANUW_IN_REVIEW) for a lease application. Approval / rejection uses the common setLoanUnderwritingStatus service.

service.name: financeValidateLeaseUnderwritingApproval
service.description: Approval validator for LEASE underwritings (registered as underwriting.approval.validator.LEASE): the lease application must exist and have at least one requested asset

service.name: createLeaseQuote
service.description: Calculate the lease payment and create an immutable lease quote with its asset lines and quote payment schedule. Acquisition cost = sum of the requested assets.

attribute.name: monthlyRateFactor
attribute.description: rate factor method; exclusive with calcInterestRate

attribute.name: calcInterestRate
attribute.description: interest rate method (annual); exclusive with monthlyRateFactor

attribute.name: residualValue
attribute.description: defaults to acquisition cost x product residual value rate

attribute.name: paymentTimingEnumId
attribute.description: defaults to the product payment timing

attribute.name: leaseStartDate
attribute.description: expected lease start; defaults to today

attribute.name: components
attribute.description: STEP L9: lease payment components. Each entry is a Map with componentTypeEnumId, monthlyAmount, taxClassEnumId (LEASE_TAX_CLASS, default taxable), revenueTreatmentEnumId (LEASE_CMP_REVENUE, default separate) and an optional description.

service.name: setLeaseQuoteStatus
service.description: Change the status of a lease quote (StatusValidChange); only one accepted quote per application

service.name: createLeaseAgreement
service.description: Create a lease agreement (LEASEAGR_CONTRACTED) from an approved application, accepted quote and approved LEASE underwriting; register the FinanceContract (LEASE) and snapshot the payment schedule and assets

attribute.name: leaseApplicationId
attribute.description: passed through for the UI redirect

service.name: setLeaseAgreementStatus
service.description: Change the status of a lease agreement (StatusValidChange) and project it onto FinanceContract. CONTRACTED -> ACTIVE is rejected here (acceptLeaseAgreement only); cancellation is rejected once an asset is purchased.

service.name: recordLeaseAssetPurchase
service.description: Record the purchase of one agreement asset: supplier purchase invoice (READY; core GL Dr lease asset suspense / Cr accounts payable), lessor-owned FixedAsset and the link to the agreement asset

attribute.name: supplierPartyId
attribute.description: defaults to the supplier of the asset line

service.name: payLeaseAssetPurchase
service.description: Pay the supplier invoice of a purchased lease asset with a core vendor payment (core GL for the payment and its application)

service.name: acceptLeaseAgreement
service.description: Record the lessee's acceptance: the acceptance date becomes the lease start, the confirmed schedule is re-dated as a new revision, the agreement becomes LEASEAGR_ACTIVE and the start entries are posted once (idempotent)

attribute.name: taxAcctgTransId
attribute.description: lump-sum consumption tax at the start (STEP L5)

service.name: createLeaseInstallmentInvoice
service.description: Bill one installment of the confirmed lease payment schedule (ACTIVE agreement, due by today): SALES_INVOICE (READY) with the lease payment (credits the lease investment / receivable) and the consumption tax (credits tax received); the core debits accounts receivable. Idempotent per installment.

service.name: recognizeLeaseProfit
service.description: Release the deferred lease profit earned (interest method) from the day after the last recognition through the recognition date, one record and one transaction per calendar month (Dr deferred lease profit / Cr deferred lease profit release). Re-running creates nothing twice.

service.name: runLeaseMonthlyAccountingBatch
service.description: For every ACTIVE lease (or the given one): bill the installments due through the processing date in due-date order, then release the deferred lease profit through the processing date

attribute.name: createdDepreciationCount
attribute.description: STEP L12: depreciation periods of operating leases

service.name: runLeaseAgreementMonthlyAccounting
service.description: Internal: monthly accounting of one ACTIVE lease in its own transaction (billing due installments, then the deferred profit release through the processing date)

attribute.name: createdDepreciationCount
attribute.description: STEP L12: depreciation periods of operating leases

service.name: receiveLeasePayment
service.description: Receive a customer payment (PMNT_RECEIVED) for an ACTIVE lease and apply it to the given lease invoice, or to the open lease invoices oldest due first; the amount may not exceed the open amount

service.name: getLeaseAgreementBalance
service.description: Collection status of a lease from the valid payment applications on its invoices (tax, then interest, then principal) and the deferred profit recognized

attribute.name: leasedAssetCost
attribute.description: STEP L12 (operating): acquisition cost of the leased assets

service.name: runLeaseExpiryBatch
service.description: For ACTIVE leases ending within monthsAhead months: expiry notice task; after the lease end, a return task per asset (no transfer) or an ownership transfer task once every installment is settled (transfer). Idempotent.

service.name: issueLeaseExpiryNotice
service.description: Record the expiry notice to the lessee (one per agreement) and complete the notice task

service.name: returnLeaseAsset
service.description: Record the return of an asset (no ownership transfer, on or after the lease end); completes the return task, creates the disposal task and completes the agreement when every asset is back and everything is settled

service.name: disposeLeaseAsset
service.description: Record the sale / scrap of a returned asset and settle its residual value (gain / loss); completes the disposal task

service.name: transferLeaseOwnership
service.description: Transfer the ownership of the assets of a transfer lease to the lessee after the final payment; settles the residual with the transfer price, updates FixedAsset.partyId, completes the task and the agreement

service.name: completeLeaseAgreement
service.description: Complete a lease (LEASEAGR_COMPLETED) when every asset is returned / disposed / transferred and every installment is billed and settled (e.g. after the last payment arrives); releases the deferred profit through the end

service.name: receiveLeaseAdvance
service.description: Receive an advance lease payment (LSADV_LEASE, Cr advance lease payments) or a security deposit (LSADV_DEPOSIT, Cr security deposits) for a CONTRACTED or ACTIVE lease (core CUSTOMER_DEPOSIT payment). Advance lease payments are applied to the open lease invoices at once and to every later lease invoice.

service.name: settleLeaseAdvances
service.description: Settle the advance lease payments and security deposits: apply them to the unpaid lease invoices (advance first, oldest first) and refund the rest (core CUSTOMER_REFUND, PMNT_SENT). Allowed when CONTRACTED (refund before a cancellation), TERMINATED, or ACTIVE with every installment billed and every asset returned / disposed / transferred; then completes the lease when every other condition holds.

service.name: resolveLeasePublicChargeEstimate
service.description: Estimate the public charge equivalent of an asset (group) for the L9 component, by the charge type's calculation method: VALUE = valuation (旧定率法相当) x special ratio x the jurisdiction rate; UNIT = annual amount of the rate class x quantity. Averaged over the term (yearly / monthly). The 免税点 is not applied.

attribute.name: municipalityGeoId
attribute.description: core Geo (MUNICIPALITY) of the location; empty = standard rate

service.name: setLeaseAssetPublicChargeAttributes
service.description: Set the public charge attributes of an agreement asset: municipality, useful life, the lessor's ownership share (0 < share <= 1) and the rate class of a charge type (LeaseAssetPublicCharge).

service.name: generateLeasePublicChargeDeclarations
service.description: Generate the public charge declarations of a lessor organization for a tax year: for each charge type (or the given one), the lessor-owned non-transfer leased assets subject to it (by asset type) acquired before its assessment date, assessed by its calculation method and grouped by jurisdiction. Idempotent per org x charge type x year x jurisdiction.

service.name: recordLeasePublicChargePayment
service.description: Record the payment of a declaration and book Dr public charge expense (租税公課) / Cr public charge payable (未払租税公課), with the GL account types of the charge type. Idempotent per declaration.

service.name: migrateLeasePropertyTaxData
service.description: STEP L10b one-time migration: copy the STEP L10 rows (LeasePropertyTaxRate / Decl / DeclAsset / Payment) to the LeasePublicCharge* tables as the depreciable asset tax (LSPC_DEPR_ASSET). Idempotent; legacy rows are kept.

service.name: reverseLeaseAcceptance
service.description: Reverse a mistaken acceptance (lease start) when nothing was processed after it (billing, deferred profit release, depreciation, payment, re-lease, change of terms, maintenance, expiry, public charges, delinquency): reverse the start entries, restore the pre-acceptance schedule as a new revision, back to LEASEAGR_CONTRACTED.

service.name: reverseLeaseTermination
service.description: Reverse a mistaken early termination when nothing was processed after it (payment of the damages, other payments, asset recovery, delinquency): cancel the damages invoice, reverse the settlement, restore the re-leases and maintenance plans, cancel the recovery tasks, back to LEASEAGR_ACTIVE.

service.name: reverseLeaseModification
service.description: Reverse the latest change of terms when nothing was processed after it (billing of the changed installments, deferred profit release, depreciation): reverse the adjustment entry, restore the previous schedule as a new revision and the previous terms.

service.name: calculateLeaseModification
service.description: The change of terms of an ACTIVE lease (term / monthly amount / calculation rate) from the first unbilled installment, without applying it.

attribute.name: newTermMonths
attribute.description: new total lease term in months (at least the first unbilled installment); empty = unchanged

attribute.name: newMonthlyLeaseAmount
attribute.description: new monthly lease amount (tax excluded); the calculation interest rate is solved

attribute.name: newCalcInterestRate
attribute.description: new annual calculation interest rate (used when no monthly amount is given; empty = current)

service.name: createLeaseModification
service.description: Change the terms of an ACTIVE lease (no re-lease) from the first unbilled installment: rebuild the confirmed schedule as a new revision recovering the same principal, adjust the lease investment and deferred lease profit (finance) or the depreciation spread (operating), update the agreement and keep the history (LeaseModification). Leases taxed in full at the start cannot change the total lease payments.

attribute.name: newTermMonths
attribute.description: new total lease term in months (at least the first unbilled installment); empty = unchanged

attribute.name: newMonthlyLeaseAmount
attribute.description: new monthly lease amount (tax excluded); the calculation interest rate is solved

attribute.name: newCalcInterestRate
attribute.description: new annual calculation interest rate (used when no monthly amount is given; empty = current)

service.name: calculateLeaseTerminationDamages
service.description: Termination damages (規定損害金) if an ACTIVE lease were terminated on terminationDate: present value of the unbilled lease payments due after it at the calculation interest rate / 12 (optionally the residual value). No change.

attribute.name: terminationDate
attribute.description: defaults to today; between the lease start and today, not after the last re-lease end

service.name: terminateLeaseAgreement
service.description: Terminate an ACTIVE lease early: bill the installments due through the termination date, account the lease through it, settle the lease investment (finance) / keep the asset at book value (operating), recognize the unearned re-lease fees (no refund), bill the damages (不課税), set LEASEAGR_TERMINATED, end the maintenance plans and create an asset recovery task per asset. Idempotent (one termination per agreement).

attribute.name: assigneePartyId
attribute.description: assignee of the asset recovery tasks

service.name: createLeaseReLease
service.description: Register the next re-lease period of an ACTIVE lease without ownership transfer (every asset still leased): it starts the day after the previous end (lease end or previous re-lease). The fee defaults to the monthly lease amount x reLeaseAnnualFactor x months / 12.

service.name: cancelLeaseReLease
service.description: Cancel the last re-lease period while it is contracted (not billed).

service.name: billLeaseReLease
service.description: Start a contracted re-lease: bill the fee in advance (due at the period start, Cr unearned re-lease fees, tax at the rate of the period start); at the first re-lease of a finance lease move the residual value to leased assets. Idempotent. The monthly accounting batch does this when the period starts.

service.name: processLeaseReLeases
service.description: Re-lease accounting of an ACTIVE lease through processingDate: start the periods begun, recognize the fee (Dr unearned / Cr re-lease revenue) and depreciate the book value of the assets for every month ended. Idempotent. Also run by the monthly accounting batch.

service.name: depreciateLeaseAssets
service.description: Depreciate the leased assets of an ACTIVE operating lease (lease-term straight-line to the residual value) for every lease month ending on or before depreciationDate not yet depreciated: Dr depreciation of leased assets / Cr accumulated depreciation. Idempotent per asset x month. Also run by the monthly accounting batch.

service.name: createLeaseMaintPlan
service.description: Register a maintenance plan of an agreement asset (CONTRACTED / ACTIVE): maintenance type, interval in months, provider. On an ACTIVE lease with no first due date the plan starts at the next interval date from today.

service.name: endLeaseMaintPlan
service.description: End a maintenance plan: no schedule on or after thruDate; scheduled maintenances on or after it are cancelled.

service.name: runLeaseMaintScheduleBatch
service.description: For ACTIVE leases with maintenance plans: create the scheduled maintenances (LeaseMaintRecord, core FixedAssetMaint, WorkEffort task FINWE_MAINTENANCE) due within monthsAhead months. Idempotent per plan x due date.

service.name: createLeaseMaintenance
service.description: Register an unscheduled maintenance (repair) of a leased asset of an ACTIVE agreement (record, core FixedAssetMaint, WorkEffort task).

service.name: completeLeaseMaintenance
service.description: Record a performed maintenance: the provider's cost (tax excluded) as a core purchase invoice (Dr maintenance cost / Cr accounts payable) when positive; completes the record, FixedAssetMaint and the task.

service.name: cancelLeaseMaintenance
service.description: Cancel a scheduled maintenance (record, core FixedAssetMaint and task).

service.name: getLeaseMaintenanceSummary
service.description: Maintenance summary of an agreement: contracted and billed maintenance revenue, cost of the completed maintenances, margin, record counts.
